text: dsh-diary 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的 Markdown 日记插件：它在 DSH 注册日记管理工具，并提供网页设置区和独立日记看板。用户可以创建、查看、筛选、修改、删除和全文搜索按日期保存的日记，也能用自定义模板生成条目。看板按月份整理记录，设置区用于查看存储目录及编辑模板。条目以 Markdown 文件保存在本机配置目录，可记录标题、日期和标签；默认目录取自 DSH_HOME 下的 diaries，或 ~/.dsh/diaries。适合希望在 DSH 中持续记录并管理工作日志、个人笔记的人，不需要额外 API 密钥。
我想在 DSH 里按天写 Markdown 日记，并能之后查阅。
有没有办法按月份浏览保存在本地的日记条目？
我想给日记加标题和标签，再按标签或日期筛选。
希望可以用固定模板快速生成每天的记录。
I want to keep dated Markdown journal entries from my DSH workspace.
Can I search my saved diary notes by words in their content?
dsh-diary 的功能「日记条目管理」：用户可用工具按日期和可选 slug 创建条目，记录标题、标签与 Markdown 正文；也可读取、更新或删除已有条目。 通过 DSH 日记工具或网页界面触发，内容保存在配置的日记目录中。
dsh-diary 的功能「全文搜索与筛选」：用户可按年月、标签和标题或文件名筛选条目，并在日记正文中搜索文本，获得匹配行和片段。 通过 DSH 日记工具或网页界面触发，内容保存在配置的日记目录中。
dsh-diary 的功能「自定义模板」：用户可管理 Markdown 模板，并在创建日记时渲染日期、标题、标签等占位符；额外正文可接在模板内容之后。 通过 DSH 日记工具或网页界面触发，内容保存在配置的日记目录中。
dsh-diary 的功能「网页日记看板」：网页面板将条目按月份分组，支持展开查看、创建新条目和删除条目。 通过 DSH 日记工具或网页界面触发，内容保存在配置的日记目录中。
我想从浏览器的设置页面维护日记模板。
How can I create and organize daily notes with reusable templates?

dsh-diary adds Markdown diary tools and a web board to DSH. Users can create, read, filter, update, delete, and search dated entries, and manage reusable templates. Entries are local Markdown files under DSH_HOME or ~/.dsh by default. The board groups entries by month; no API key is needed.

dsh-diary README · dsh-diary：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that gives the agent a
daily markdown journal: create entries, manage the resulting `.md` files, use custom templates, and
configure it all from a web settings section.

dsh-diary README · What it adds：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `diary_create` | Create a new entry (`YYYY-MM-DD[-slug].md`) with optional title, tags, body, and a named template |
| `diary_list` | List entries with metadata, filterable by year/month, tag, or title/filename substring |
| `diary_read` | Read one entry's frontmatter and full body |
| `diary_update` | Replace or append the body, and/or change the title and tags |
| `diary_delete` | Delete one entry file |
| `diary_search` | Full-text search across entry bodies with line numbers and snippets |
| `diary_template_list` | List the templates available to `diary_create` |
| `diary_template_read` | Read one template's full content |
| `diary_template_set` | Create or overwrite a template |
| `diary_template_delete` | Delete a template |

dsh-diary README · Custom templates：Templates are markdown files under `<diary-directory>/templates/`. `diary_create` accepts a
`template` name and substitutes these placeholders in the template body:

`{{date}}` `{{title}}` `{{tags}}` `{{slug}}` `{{year}}` `{{month}}` `{{day}}` `{{datetime}}` `{{time}}`

When both `template` and `content` are given to `diary_create`, the rendered template body comes
first and `content` is appended after a blank line.

dsh-diary README · Web GUI：The plugin ships a browser half (`lib/client.js`, served at `/plugins/dsh-diary/client.js`) with two
surfaces:

- a **「日记」settings section**: shows the diary/templates directory and lists, creates, edits, and
  deletes templates;
- a **日记看板 (diary board)**: a standalone panel (its own floating toggle button, 📓) that lists
  entries **grouped by month**, with a **「新建日记」** button and a per-entry delete action.

dsh-diary README · Web GUI：Both are backed by a `diary` Typert Remote namespace exposed under `/api/diary/*`:
`getDirectory`, `listTemplates`, `getTemplate`, `setTemplate`, `deleteTemplate`, `listEntries`,
`getEntry`, `createEntry`, `deleteEntry`.

dsh-diary README · Storage：Entries are markdown files with optional YAML frontmatter:

```markdown
---
title: My day
date: 2026-08-14
tags:

By default they live under `$DSH_HOME/diaries` (falling back to `~/.dsh/diaries`). Override the
directory in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-diary
      name: 'dsh-diary'
      config:

One entry per date is the default; pass a `slug` to `diary_create` to keep several entries on the
same day (the file becomes `YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md`).

dsh-diary README · Install：Install the published [`dsh-diary`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-diary) package into the web
profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-diary
```

Then restart the web server for the new layer (tools + settings section) to take effect.

pnpm run build    # esbuild → lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (browser) + declarations
pnpm run typecheck
node smoke.mjs    # functional smoke test of the ten tools
